title: Heating and Cooling
seo_title: Grade 2 Heating and Cooling Worksheets: Changes You Can and Cannot Undo
standard_text: Construct an argument with evidence that some changes caused by heating or cooling can be reversed and some cannot.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on heating and cooling (NGSS 2-PS1-4): melting and freezing, cooking and baking, and which changes can be undone. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Melting and freezing go back and forth. Cooking and burning do not.
body_html:
How to think about it

Heating and cooling can change things.

  • Some changes can be undone: ice melts, water freezes.
  • Some cannot: cooking, baking, burning.
  • Test it: try to change it back.
Example

Butter melts in a pan. Can it change back?

Cool it.

Answer: Yes, it gets solid again.

Example

Bread is toasted. Can it change back?

Cooling does not make soft bread.

Answer: No.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a cooked egg can become raw if you cool it.
  • Thinking melted things disappear. They are still there as a liquid.
  • Mixing up melting (heating) and freezing (cooling).

faq.a: Melting and freezing: ice and water, chocolate, butter, wax and crayons can change back.
Cooking an egg, baking a cake, toasting bread and burning paper make something new that cannot change back.
Try to change it back by cooling or warming it, and observe what happens.
